positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Deployed an asynchronous pipeline service that automates the delivery of test results from Google’s database to Android’s test storage
• Assembled a scalable server for the service and set up load balancing resources for its traffic
• Optimized for inserts by combining multiple subrequests into a single callable batch. Saved 602ms in latency per 3000 test results requested
• Developed a client server with write access to the Android Build API. Scoped authorization to the Android team by leveraging GAIA, Google Cloud’s ID system, to provide access control
• Installed logging resources and stack trace APIs for observability
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Pipelines · Systems Design · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

projects.title: Match Simulator
projects.description:
Engineered an Android simulation with Java to predict live gamescores with 62 percent success rate
Remodeled the Monte Carlo predictive algorithm to include home game advantages with a multiplicative constant
Assembled Simulator data with REST API calls for 13 years of data, aggregated to calculate home advantage
Optimized REST API calls with Retrofit, increasing the basic packet latency efficiency from 941 ms to 312 ms

projects.title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
projects.description:
Built a sorting visualizer to familiarize Spring semester students with the course material.
Featured a timer and an interactive window for users to switch between sorting algorithms and compare their speeds.
